turns.sql:
WITH labelled AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.transaction_type AS transaction_type_1,
    l.state AS merchant_state_1,
    l.city AS merchant_city_1,
    l.state AS merchant_city_2,
    m.mcc AS merchant_category_1,
    c.description AS merchant_category_2,
    CAST(strftime('%H', t.date) AS INTEGER) AS hour_1,
    COALESCE(t.errors, 'No error') AS error_1,
    CASE WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 0 THEN 'negative'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 1000 THEN '$0 to under $10'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 5000 THEN '$10 to under $50'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 10000 THEN '$50 to under $100'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 50000 THEN '$100 to under $500'
      WHEN t.amount_usd_cents < 100000 THEN '$500 to under $1,000'
      ELSE '$1,000 and over' END AS amount_band_1,
    k.card_type AS card_type_1,
    k.card_brand AS card_brand_1,
    f.is_fraud AS is_fraud
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN merchant_locations l ON l.id = t.merchant_location_id
  LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = t.merchant_id
  LEFT JOIN mcc_codes c ON c.mcc = m.mcc
  LEFT JOIN cards k ON k.id = t.card_id
  WHERE f.is_fraud IS NOT NULL
),
segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT 'transaction_type' AS dimension, transaction_type_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
  FROM labelled GROUP BY transaction_type_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'merchant_state' AS dimension, merchant_state_1 AS key1, NULL AS key2,
         count(*) AS labelled, sum(is_fraud) AS fraud
